title: Document templates and the dir-driven build_type
description: Add an 'authoring a template' recipe (folder layout, template.json contract, the {{slug}}/{{summary}} variables, required_files, 'a folder is all it takes'). Update HOWTO.md and README.md scaffold sections to mention `appbuilder templates` and the open build_type, and update .agent/plan-interview.md to point at the live `appbuilder templates` list instead of a hardcoded enum. Docs only.
acceptance_criteria: A template-authoring recipe documents the folder layout, manifest contract, substitution variables, and required_files.
HOWTO.md/README.md mention `appbuilder templates` and the dir-driven build_type; .agent/plan-interview.md points at the live list rather than a fixed enum.
No stale 'no template for X yet' or closed-enum language remains where it is now wrong; full suite passes (docs-only change).
